description: Debt-backlog record — a queued structural/technical-debt entry, one YAML file per entry under state/debt-backlog/<date>-<slug>.yaml (whole-document YAML; no prose markdown body). additionalProperties-posture: open — unknown fields in debt-backlog records are tolerated (not rejected). This preserves forward-compatibility as new optional fields are added without invalidating existing records. Decision: keep open; tighten only if strict-mode corpus conformance enforcement is required at a future governance stage.
_additionalProperties_note: Permissive by design — additionalProperties is not set to false here, consistent with the handoff/goal schemas. A misspelled field will silently pass. This is intentional for forward-compatibility and matches the existing permissive pattern in other coordinator schemas.

created.description: Date this debt-backlog entry was authored (YYYY-MM-DD).

title.description: Short business-legible title for this debt entry.

body.description: Prose description of the debt — what it is and why it matters.

status.description: Lifecycle status. open=unresolved; closed=resolved (git mv to archive/debt-backlog/<YYYY-MM>/ on closure); deferred=explicitly deprioritized.

source.description: Where this debt entry originated (e.g. a review finding, an audit, a session observation).

risk.description: Prose statement of the risk this debt poses if left unaddressed.

proposed_action.description: Prose statement of the recommended remediation.

from_repo.description: Originating repo, when the debt entry was raised cross-repo.

surface.description: The code/doc surface this debt entry concerns.

closed_at.description: Date this debt entry was closed (YYYY-MM-DD). Present only once status transitions to closed.

closed_by.description: Session or agent identifier that closed this entry.

evidence.description: Supporting evidence for the debt claim (file:line, log excerpt, link).

severity.description: Priority severity of the debt entry, P0 highest.

initiative.description: FK to state/initiatives/<id>.yaml; nullable — absent≡null. Spec backlink: pln-initiative-govern-sweep-priori-6cf808 § C0

created_by_session.description: Session identifier that authored this entry.

created_by_agent.description: Agent type that authored this entry.

linked_sessions.description: Session identifiers linked to this entry's history.

linked_commits.description: Commit SHAs linked to this entry's history.

provenance_completeness.description: Whether the provenance chain (session/agent/commits) is fully recorded or unknown.
